title: She Bends the Light to Her Will
summary: A moon floats in the room and sends its light to the ground. Move the light to find the words hidden there. A collaboration with Feather Miigwans.
description: She Bends the Light to Her Will is a collaboration with Feather Miigwans. Feather designed the work from her first memory of Grandmother Moon, and I built it in augmented reality.

A moon floats in front of you and throws a cone of light down to a star on the ground. The star goes where you point. Seven words lie hidden in the dark, and each one shows for a few seconds when the light passes over it: she bends the light to her will.

We made it for La Leun Waashisho, an augmented reality exhibition presented by Harbour Collective with PIX FILM Collective and Setzkasten, which opened at the MuseumsQuartier in Vienna in November 2024.
howTo: Press Enter in the frame above. The sound starts with it, and Sound on or off is at the top right.
Move your mouse across the ground to move the light. On a phone, drag one finger.
Pass the light over a word to show it. The words change places while they are hidden.
For AR, tap AR on a phone to open the camera in a new tab, or scan the code. Tap Start AR and allow the camera and motion sensors.
The moon appears in front of you. Point your phone at the ground ahead and the star follows. Tap the screen to bring the moon back in front of you.
Tap the round camera button to take a photo, then save or share it.
embedNote: Enter, then move the light across the ground to find the words. On a phone, tap AR to open the camera.
